messages:
alex: swing shift here — quick handoff. Observed autoscaler churn in eu-west1 between ~02:10–02:40 UTC during a canary rollout for model-routing PR #412. Short-lived pod restarts and a few OOM kills on inference workers. I paused the canary and scaled the dedicated pool temporarily to 6 nodes, which brought error rates down.

ops-bot: Alert: autoscaler-flap detected in eu-west1 (3 events). CPU spike + rapid pod churn.

maya: thanks — can you paste the OOM lines you saw?

alex: logs snippet below (truncated):
```
kubelet: Evicting pod "inference-worker-7" - memory pressure
kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (inference_worker) score 950 or sacrifice child
containerd: container exited with status 137
```

samir: I reverted PR #412 at 02:30 and paused the rollout. After the revert churn slowed down — error rate dropped from ~4.2% -> ~0.8% within 5m.

jin: noted. I'll open a tiny PR to add a preStop hook + bump terminationGracePeriod to reduce mid-termination KS race. Will reference this thread.

infra-team: seeing the HPA oscillation too. We'll check the HPA target/metrics and the cluster autoscaler cooldowns. Suggest increasing scaleDownDelay to avoid aggressive downscales during canary.

maya: blockers for next steps: need a short soak (30–60m) in staging with the reverted image + the preStop change, then re-run canary with a slower ramp. Also add an e2e that simulates mem pressure.

alex: agreed. Next steps (TL;DR):
  1) jin -> PR #421: preStop + terminationGracePeriod (today)
  2) infra-team -> adjust autoscaler cooldown/scaleDownDelay to 90s and review HPA metric smoothing (today)
  3) maya -> run 1h soak in staging once PR merged, then re-run canary with 10% traffic increments every 15m
  4) samir -> monitor eu-west1 for 2h, escalate if >2 autoscaler events in 30m

samir: I'm on watch for the next 2 hours, will notify if anything spikes.

maya: I'll take the next handoff in 2 hours and follow up on soak results. Will also add the e2e test ticket to the sprint. :thumbsup:

alex: if anyone needs to rebuild the canary quickly: command we used to pause/resume the rollout:
```
kubectl rollout pause deploy/model-router-canary -n prod-eu-west1
kubectl rollout resume deploy/model-router-canary -n prod-eu-west1
```

alex: Oncall escalation: if error-rate > 2% or autoscaler events > 2 within 30m, page @eng-sre. Leaving notes in the incident tracker with links to logs. Handoff complete.
